overview: MediaFolio is a media portfolio platform for photographers, videographers, and audio creators. Upload and showcase your work in beautiful public portfolios, connect with other creators through likes, comments, and follows, and discover inspiring projects. Features a clean black-and-white design, batch multi-file uploads, and social interactions.
features: Public landing page with About Us and Contact Us sections
Internet Identity login and user profiles
Batch multi-file photo, video, and audio uploads
Likes on projects with live counts
Follow/unfollow other creators with follower counts
Public shareable portfolio pages per user
